meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'at, near, with', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: You are gravely mistaken.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'us', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: We are a classic French restaurant.

examples.text: Мы с тобой в кафешку сходим?
examples.trans: Shall you and I go to a little cafe?

examples.text: Мы искали, но никто не подошел.
examples.trans: We looked, but nobody suited us.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'there is'.

examples.trans: You want to be fashionable, don't you.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'duplicate copies' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: У нас есть дубликаты. Сейчас подпишем.
examples.trans: We have duplicate copies. We will sign now.
I always keep a duplicate.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: У него сейчас рост восемь сантиметров.
examples.trans: He is only eight centimeters tall right now.

examples.text: А как у тебя с Викой сейчас?
examples.trans: And how are things with Vika for you now?

examples.text: Сейчас Катя продемонстрирует блюда молекулярной кухни.
examples.trans: Now Katya will demonstrate dishes of molecular cuisine.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'писать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will sign', paired with 'подписывать'.

examples.text: Пока всё не подпишешь, не выйдешь.
examples.trans: You won't leave until you sign everything.
Sign here, please.

examples.text: Пока всё не подпишешь, отсюда не выйдешь.
examples.trans: You're not leaving here until you sign everything.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: All right. Excellent.
Agreed? Well, all right.

examples.text: Хорошо! По вкусу просто томатный суп.
examples.trans: Good! By taste it is simply tomato soup.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'толик'). Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'table' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'просить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'asked', paired with 'просить'.

examples.trans: Why did you ask for champagne?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'метить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'notices, will notice', paired with 'замечать'.

examples.trans: And what if he notices?

examples.text: Ничего он не заметит. Мне он доверяет.
